title: Design System: SAHAD UBV — Eje Kerepakupai Vena

display.purpose: Bento stat numbers (.stat-number) with tabular numerals.

headline.purpose: Main view titles (.page-title) in module headers.

body.purpose: High-density table cells, form controls, and descriptions.

label.purpose: Table column headers (.clean-table th), stat categories, and badges.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Subtle structural depth on resting panels, Bento cards, and toolbar inputs.

shadows.name: shadow-modal
shadows.purpose: Elevated floating overlay shadow for modals and .clean-dropdown menus.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Keyboard and input focus halo paired with --border-focus.

motion.name: ease-ui
motion.purpose: Crisp state transitions on buttons, table rows, and Bento tiles.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Main CTA button with icon + explicit text label (.btn-clean-primary).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background-color: var(--brand-accent, #2f81f7); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 6px; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(56, 139, 253, 0.35); }

components.name: Secondary Action Button
components.description: Neutral navigation or secondary action button (.btn-clean-secondary).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.4rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background-color: var(--surface-card, #161b22); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #21262d); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-white, #f0f6fc); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--surface-card-hover, #1f242c); border-color: var(--border-medium, #30363d); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-focus, #388bfd); }

components.name: Table Row Action Button
components.description: Mandatory icon + visible text button for .table-actions-cell (.btn-table-action).
components.css: .ds-btn-table-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 4px 8px; background-color: var(--surface-muted, #21262d); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #21262d); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-table-action:hover { background-color: var(--surface-card-hover, #1f242c); color: var(--text-white, #f0f6fc); border-color: var(--border-medium, #30363d); } .ds-btn-table-action:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-focus, #388bfd); }

components.name: DataTable Search Input
components.css: .ds-search-box { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 260px; } .ds-search-icon { position: absolute; left: 10px; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; height: 34px; background-color: var(--surface-input, #0d1117); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #21262d); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-white, #f0f6fc); padding: 0 10px 0 32px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-search-input:focus, .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--border-focus, #388bfd); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(56, 139, 253, 0.12); }

components.name: Curriculum Hours & Priority Chips
components.description: Semantic tinted chips for HT/HP/HC hours and availability priorities.
components.html: HT: 2hHP: 2hHC: 4h
components.css: .ds-chip-group { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-ht { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); color: #60a5fa; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); } .ds-chip-hp { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12); color: #34d399; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25); } .ds-chip-hc { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12); color: #fbbf24; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25); }

components.name: Bento Stat Card
components.description: High-density metric card with tabular numerals and progress indicator (.clean-stat-card).
components.html:

components.css: .ds-stat-card { background-color: var(--surface-card, #161b22); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #21262d); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; width: 240px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-stat-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-medium, #30363d); } .ds-stat-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-stat-cat { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); } .ds-stat-badge { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.12); color: #3fb950; } .ds-stat-val { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-stat-num { font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--text-white, #f0f6fc); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1; } .ds-stat-unit { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted, #8b949e); } .ds-progress { width: 100%; height: 4px; background: var(--surface-muted, #21262d); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-progress-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--brand-primary, #238636); border-radius: 999px; }

narrative.overview:
SAHAD UBV projects the calm authority of an algorithmic command console engineered for public university timetabling. Built for academic planners, PFG coordinators, administrators, and faculty across the Eje Geopolítico Regional Kerepakupai Vena, the visual system treats high-density data—45-minute schedule matrices, 29-column .xlsx offer imports, CCU dedication thresholds (DE, TC, MT, TV), and curriculum trajectories—with surgical clarity. Every surface prioritizes immediate scannability, explicit action labeling, and normative traceability over decorative flourish.

The aesthetic philosophy draws from dark-first technical workspaces (Linear and GitHub Dark) adapted to institutional academic governance, paired with a high-contrast light mode for bright offices and projectors. It explicitly rejects ornamental gradients, unstyled native controls, ambiguous icon-only action capsules, and low-density marketing cards that waste vertical viewport space during intensive planning sessions.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first dual-theme architecture (data-theme="dark" default with seamless data-theme="light" parity).
High-density tabular and matrix layouts (SahadDataTable and weekly availability/schedule grids) governed by server-side pagination and HTMX partial swaps.
Explicit icon-plus-label affordances on every table and workflow action.
Semantic status encoding for hard (H-01..H-14) and soft (S-01..S-08) normative rules, priorities (P1-P3), and curriculum hour breakdowns (HT, HP, HC).
Venezuelan 12-hour civil time formatting (hh:mm AM/PM) with tabular numerals across all temporal views.

rules.name: The Semantic Tinted-Surface Rule
rules.body: Status badges, matrix priority cells, and alerts never use solid saturated fills; they pair a low-opacity tinted background (0.12 alpha in dark, 0.08 in light) with a 1px translucent border (0.25–0.40 alpha) and a high-contrast semantic foreground text color.

rules.name: The Crimson Restraint Rule
rules.body: Bolivarian Crimson (#f85149) is reserved strictly for the UBV header wordmark, hard normative conflicts, and destructive actions—never for decorative highlights or neutral navigation.

rules.name: The Civil Time & Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: All schedule blocks, availability matrices, and audit timestamps must render in 12-hour Venezuelan civil format (hh:mm AM/PM) with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (tnum) so columns align vertically to the pixel.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Elevation Rule
rules.body: Never rely on blur shadows alone to separate surfaces; every card, panel, input, and badge is bounded by an explicit 1px border token (--border-subtle at rest, --border-medium on hover).

dos: Do define all component styles in src/public/css/style.css (and its src/public/css/modules/*.css imports) using CSS custom properties from variables.css so both dark and light themes render with full fidelity.

Do include both a semantic icon () and a visible text label (Texto) inside every table action button (.btn-table-action), grouped inside .table-actions-cell > .table-actions-group aligned to the right.
Do format all hours and schedule blocks in 12-hour Venezuelan civil format (AM/PM) and execute all table pagination, sorting, and filtering on the server via SahadDataTable + HTMX.
Do style dropdown menus formally with .clean-dropdown and .dropdown-action-btn using semantic color classes (.text-danger, .text-success).
donts: Don't render icon-only action buttons, empty pill buttons, or unstyled native browser controls in any table or form.
Don't hardcode dark-only hex colors or inline style attributes in EJS templates that break data-theme="light" or bypass the modular stylesheet.
Don't load full database tables into the client DOM without server-side pagination (skip/take), or use 24-hour military time in user-facing schedule views.
